answer: The European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS) deliberately did not issue its 2024 generative AI guidelines in its role as AI Supervisor of the EU institutions, bodies, offices, and agencies (EUIs) under the EU's Artificial Intelligence Act. Instead, a separate strategy is being prepared for that capacity. The guidelines published in 2024 were issued within the EDPS's role as the independent data protection authority of the EUIs to help them comply with data protection obligations under Regulation (EU) 2018/1725.
